race.comment: MISS PARTON (1) wasn't one of the better fancies in the small field over this course and distance last start but led all the way and dominated, defeating a couple of today's key rivals with ease in the process. Meets those runners 3kgs worse off today but that should not be enough to stop her. The danger probably comes from the unraced Richard and Chantelle Jolly-trained COOL NO MORE (2) who has looked good in his two jump-outs to date, the latest a win here over 850m. Looks ready to run a big race. DARK ICE (5) and PATONG EXPRESS (3) settled behind MISS PARTON here three weeks ago and made no impression. Each should improve with that maiden run out of the way and with a decent swing in the weights all is not lost. First starter WRITTEN SUPREME (4) is trialling well for trainer Dylan Caboche. A bright start looks on the cards.
